Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine your eligibility for Child Benefit. I can see you're asking about two children - Alex (11 years old) and Blake (17 years old).

Before I can make a final determination, I need to clarify one important piece of information:

**Do you live in the UK?**

This is a fundamental requirement for Child Benefit eligibility, as you normally need to live in the UK to qualify (with some exceptions for Crown servants or those living in certain countries).

Once you confirm this, I'll be able to assess your eligibility for both Alex and Blake based on your specific circumstances.
